mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.05% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales are rising, it indicates a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 2.5% signals higher inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 6% and payroll employment is rising, it indicates a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 6 and PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP indicates a slowing economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 is declining.
